prior_year_events.impact_description: Increase in gross technical provisions of GBP 370,000 due to change in mortality assumptions in 2014; no such change in 2015

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 308 (life) shows a release in long-term technical provisions during the 36 months to 31 December 2015. The gross long-term business provision at the start of the year (comparative 2014 column) was GBP 8.047m and the gross change in the long-term business provision in the year was a release of GBP 1.964m (a c.24.4% reduction versus opening). The accounts note there was a mortality assumption-driven increase of GBP 0.37m in 2014 but no such assumption change in 2015; the main observable movement in 2015 therefore reflects favourable development/re-estimation in the long-term business provision.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken as 'Long-term business provision' (prior-year comparative column) because Syndicate 308 (life) does not present a 'Gross claims outstanding' line analogous to non-life; mapping long-term provision to 'claims outstanding' is an approximation. Prior-year movement uses the 'Change in the long-term business provision: Gross amount' line from the long-term business technical account (explicit gross figure). There is an explicit note that mortality assumptions changed in 2014 (+GBP 0.37m) but no mortality assumption change in 2015. No gross claims development triangle was found for Syndicate 308 in the underwriting year accounts; therefore the prior-year development was taken from the Statement of Technical Account. If a more detailed gross PYD breakdown by accident year is required, it was not present in the report.
